description: PvE out in the world: hunting a camp, dungeons, dying and coming back, being raised where you fell, and levelling up.

lines.text: These {target} drop a fair bit of loot for their trouble.
Watch for adds on those. They seldom come alone.
Torch lit, pack light, nerves steady. Heading deeper into {zone}.
Pull them back to the corridor. The open rooms are asking for trouble.
Well, {target} won that round. Back from my bind point and a little wiser.
Many thanks for the rez. I owe somebody a drink.
Level {level} at last! Off to my trainer before anything else.
Level {level}. New spells to try, and new ways to pull aggro, I expect.
Grats! Spend those points wisely.
This {target} camp respawns quicker than I can sit and regen.
Third {target} in a row and still no drop worth keeping.
Anyone know if a {target} ever drops anything besides vendor trash?
The {target} here con blue to me now. Steady work, at least.
Nice spot. The {target} wander in two at a time, no more.
Pulled a {target} and its friend came along. Typical.
Every {target} in this field seems to know my name by now.
Clearing {target} until my bags are full or my nerve runs out.
Careful near the {target}, stand too close and the whole pack comes.
One more {target} and I think I can call it a good night.
Who left all these {target} corpses lying about? Oh. Me.
That {target} hit far harder than a yellow con has any right to.
Found a quiet {target} camp in {zone}. Shh, nobody tell anyone.
Another handful of copper off a {target}. I shall be rich by winter.
Sitting to regen between {target} pulls. Slow but safe.
That {target} ran off at low health and brought back help. Rude.
Grey cons now, this {target} lot. Time to move on, I suppose.
Killed a {target} without taking a scratch. Do not get used to it.
If one more {target} wanders in mid-fight I am going home.
Hunting {target} in {zone}. Bags filling up nicely.
Good hunting today. The {target} con orange, but they die slow and steady.
Ah, a {target} that cons purple. I will just walk the other way.
{target} down. Loot is mostly hide and hope.
The {target} drops are filling my pack faster than I can sell them.
Lost track of how many {target} I have put down today.
Watching a {target} patrol its loop. Waiting for my moment.
A {target} just walked right through my camp like it owned the place.
That {target} was carrying more coin than I was.
This {target} spot is perfect for my level. Steady pull, steady kill.
Someone else is camping the {target} too. Plenty for both of us, I hope.
Watch out, a {target} spawned right on top of me.
The {target} here hit hard but go down easy. My kind of fight.
Another {target} falls. Small victories add up.
My arms ache from swinging at {target} all afternoon.
Kiting this {target} round the hill like a fool. It is working, mind.
Pet is chewing on a {target}. I am mostly here for moral support.
Healing myself between {target} pulls. Lonely work for a healer.
Snuck up on a {target} for a nice opener. Ever so satisfying.
Arrows are running low and the {target} keep coming.
Mana is gone, the {target} is not. Sitting down to think about life.
Guild, I found a {target} camp with no one on it. Come along if you are free.
Evening all. Out hunting {target} in {zone}, quiet so far.
Hunting {target} near {zone}, if anyone in {guild} wants company.
Blue cons all round. Not exciting, but my bags are filling.
This camp is all mine. Pull, kill, sit, repeat.
Nothing like a quiet camp and a full pack.
Two adds and a wandering patrol. Some days the hunt hunts you.
Yellow con, no adds, fair fight. Here goes.
Orange con. Either I win big or I see my bind point.
The loot table here must be made of rocks and fur.
Out of potions, nearly out of patience, still hunting.
Sun is going down over {zone}. Good time for one last pull.
Nice drop! Something shiny that I cannot use at all.
Bags full. Time to trudge back to a merchant.
Finally got a drop worth more than the walk back to town.
Fighting near the zone line. If it goes bad I am running.
Pulling with care. Last time I rushed it I met three of their cousins.
Quiet camp, warm weather, and a steady stream of experience.
The experience here is good, but the walk to the camp is long.
Grinding away in {zone}. Slow and steady fills the bar.
If anyone sees a wandering patrol, shout. I am facing the wall.
Someone left a good camp open near the old ruins. Bless them.
My weapon needs repair after this camp. Worth it.
Greens give nothing, reds give a corpse run. Blue and yellow for me.
Hunting alone tonight. The camp does not argue back.
That one ran. I hate it when they run.
Patience and a good camp, that is all a hunter needs.
Just cleared the whole camp. Now I wait for the respawn.
Someone trained a whole pack past me. Thanks for that.
Low on health, but so is it. Who blinks first?
Every pull is a little gamble out here.
Pack heavy with hides and teeth. Some merchant will be pleased.
Took a breather on a hill. You can see half of {zone} from here.
Found a camp in {zone} with good spawns and no one else around.
Steady hunting in {zone} today. Nothing to report, which is lovely.
Ah, a rare spawn up ahead. Or it might just be a rock.
I could do this camp in my sleep. Nearly am, in fact.
Hunting out on Salisbury Plains. Wide open and nowhere to hide.
Campacorentin Forest is busy today. Every clearing has someone in it.
Black Mountains hunting is slow, but the views are worth it.
Lyonesse is crawling with things that want me dead. Good experience, though.
Back in the Camelot Hills, clearing out the little ones for old times sake.
Avalon Marsh mud in every crevice of my armour. Still hunting.
Myrkwood is dark as a cellar, but the hunting pays.
Out by the Vale of Mularn. Easy pickings, cold wind.
Raumarik is no place for the timid. Watch your back out there.
Svealand hunting today. Wolves and worse, as usual.
Malmohus is cold enough to freeze a dwarf's beard. Still out here.
Gotar is quiet. Too quiet for my liking.
Lough Derg is lovely this time of day. Shame about everything trying to bite me.
Hunting in Connacht. The little ones still give me a laugh.
Cliffs of Moher hunting. Mind the edge, it is a long way down.
Bog of Cullen smells worse every time I come back.
Silvermine Mountains are cold, but the camps are good.
Sheeroe Hills hunting. Keep an eye on the high ground.
Same here. Slow, but the experience adds up.
Keep an eye on your health bar. That is all I ever say.
Sounds better than my camp. Mine keeps running off.
Mind the wanderers. They always arrive at the worst moment.
Good hunting to you.
Pull small, rest often. Old advice, still good.
Ha, I had the same luck earlier.
Careful, the patrols around there cut right through.
Keep at it. The bar moves eventually.
Better you than me. I am staying well away from that lot.
Loot is loot. Even the rubbish sells for something.
Any good drops yet?
Not bad at all. My camp is thinner than gruel tonight.
Watch the con colours. Orange gets serious very fast.
Agreed. Nothing beats a quiet camp.
Be careful. I lost a good while out there to bad pulls.
Shout if it goes wrong. Someone will hear.
Heh, sounds about right.
Make sure you have a path back to the zone line.
I know that sort of camp. The respawn catches you sitting every time.
Bring potions next time. Learned that one the hard way.
Good luck. Do not get greedy with the pulls.
Sounds like a fine evening of hunting.
That is how it goes. Patience pays out here.
My bags are full too. Merchant run soon.
If you find a better spot, do share.
Nice. Save me a few, would you?
Keep your back to a wall and you will do fine.
My {target} camp is no better, honestly.
Steady on. No sense rushing a good camp.
Ha! Mine did the same thing.
Count yourself lucky. My last drop was a broken tooth.
Sounds good. I am clearing a {target} camp myself.
Grey cons are a waste of time anyway. Move on when you can.
Quiet out here today. I like it that way.
Corridors here are tight. One pull at a time, please.
Something is moving in the dark ahead. Holding still.
This {target} came out of nowhere. Dungeons, honestly.
Deeper into {zone}. The air smells of old stone and worse.
Every room in {zone} looks the same. I think I have passed this pillar twice.
Pulled a {target} round the corner. Three more followed it.
Watch the pathing in here. A {target} walks right through the camp.
Clearing {target} near the entrance. Not brave enough for the lower halls yet.
Dark in here. Should have brought a better lantern.
Echoes in {zone} make every footstep sound like an add.
Found a safe corner to rest. Back to the wall, eyes open.
Took a wrong turn and found a room full of very angry company.
Dungeons are good experience if you live long enough to collect it.
Who decided to put the good camps at the very bottom?
The deeper you go, the less forgiving it gets. Keep your wits.
If I go quiet, assume the {target} won.
Careful on the stairs. Things like to wait at the bottom.
Gravestones near the entrance. Not a cheerful welcome.
Torch smoke and damp walls. Lovely place, {zone}.
Long way back to the entrance if this goes wrong.
Quiet. Too quiet. Something is about to come round that corner.
Camped at a junction with paths on three sides. Not ideal.
These walls have seen a lot of corpse runs.
Heard something drop behind us. Please be a rock.
Every {target} down here hits harder than its cousins outside.
Resting on the stairs. The {target} below can wait a moment.
Mapping {zone} in my head as I go. So far it is mostly regret.
Lower levels are where the real loot is. Also the real danger.
Every dungeon has one hallway you never want to pull into.
Crept past a camp without waking it. Small miracles.
Nothing respawns faster than the room you just cleared to rest in.
A dungeon run without a single death. I will believe it when I see it.
The damp gets into your boots down here and never leaves.
Light a candle for me if I do not make it out of {zone}.
Roaming patrol in this hall. Wait for it to pass before you pull.
Stepped on something that crunched. Not looking down.
Holding the hallway. Nothing gets past this door.
Keeping everyone's health up down here is a full time job.
Sneaking ahead to scout the next room. Stay put.
Big room ahead. One careless area spell and the whole place wakes up.
Pet first, me second. That is the dungeon rule.
No room to kite in these halls. Not my favourite place.
Guild, I am deep in {zone}. If I stop answering, send help.
Evening all. Dungeon crawl in {zone} tonight, wish me luck.
Darkness Falls tonight. The demons will not kill themselves.
Down in Darkness Falls the hallways never end. Neither do the demons.
Deep levels of {zone} are no place to wander alone at my level.
Hearing rumours of a nasty named down in the lowest halls. Not today.
First proper dungeon crawl. My knees are shaking a bit.
Only braving the top rooms for now. The deep halls can wait a few levels.
Watch for {enemyrealm} in the halls of Darkness Falls tonight.
Old hands say the lowest hall is where the worst of it waits. They are not wrong.
The Tomb of Mithra again. Those halls never get any warmer.
Keltoi Fogou is a maze. I keep meeting the same wall.
Stonehenge Barrows give me chills every time.
Tepok's Mine, all tunnels and trouble.
Avalon City is a long way down and every step is guarded.
Caer Sidi tonight, if we can find a full group. Bring your nerve.
Spindelhalla again. Spiders, spiders and more spiders.
Vendo Caverns are damp and full of nasty surprises.
Varulvhamn. Every howl down here makes my hair stand on end.
The Cursed Tomb lives up to its name, I promise you.
Nisse's Lair is the place to learn how to pull carefully.
Trollheim halls are big, cold and full of trolls. Who could have guessed.
Tuscaran Glacier is beautiful right up until it kills you.
Iarnvidiur's Lair is no place for a lone wanderer.
Muire Tomb again. The dead here do not rest easy.
Spraggon Den is small, but the spraggons are cheeky.
Koalinth Caverns. Wet feet and tired arms.
Treibh Caillte is a lost place, and I feel lost in it.
Coruscating Mine sparkles nicely, right before something jumps out.
Galladoria tonight. Only the brave or the foolish go, and I am not sure which I am.
Tur Suil is a long crawl. Bring potions and patience.
Agreed. Slow pulls in a place like this.
Stay near the wall and you will be fine.
I hate that place. Too many corners.
Mind the patrols. They come round every so often.
Keep your back to the exit. Always.
Good luck down there. Do not wake the whole floor.
Sounds grim. Keep your head down.
Listen before every corner. It has saved me more than once.
Rest when you can. Dungeons do not forgive tired hands.
Count the room before you pull. Then count it again.
Same here. Every hallway feels like a trap.
If it looks like a camp, it is three camps.
Ha, I know that feeling. Took me ages to find my way out last time.
Be careful. The deeper rooms hit much harder.
Sensible. No point rushing into the dark.
Heard the lower halls are rough tonight.
Mark your way back. You will thank yourself later.
Watch for wandering adds. They love a busy fight.
Sounds like my last trip. I came out lighter and wiser.
Do not pull the big room until everyone has mana.
Keep the healer in sight and you will be fine.
My corner is no better. A {target} keeps sneaking up behind me.
Steady does it. Dungeons punish hurry.
Agreed, open rooms are trouble. Stick to the halls.
Hope the loot is worth it down there.
Smart. Scout first, fight second.
If you hear a scream, it was probably me.
Killed by a {target}. I will not be telling anyone how.
That {target} hit like a falling tree. Back to bind I go.
Died to a {target}. Pride hurts more than the experience loss.
Note to self: the {target} has friends.
Well. That {target} conned yellow. It did not fight yellow.
Face down in the dirt thanks to a {target}. Lovely view of its boots.
Lost a fight with a {target}. Off to pray at my gravestone.
That {target} got lucky. That is my story and I am sticking to it.
Down to a {target}. Anyone nearby with a rez?
Dead. The {target} is somewhere celebrating, I expect.
That {target} will be telling stories about me tonight.
A {target} sent me home. Walking back with a grudge.
Killed by a {target} while I was sitting to regen. The cheek of it.
Overpulled. Paid for it.
Releasing to bind. It is a long walk back.
Well, that went poorly.
Died with my bags full. Of course.
Should have run three seconds earlier.
Corpse run again. I know these roads too well.
That add came from nowhere. Dead before I could blink.
Dead again. The healer in town is going to know me by name.
Lost some constitution on that one. Off to see the healer.
Gravestone placed, pride bruised. Walking back to pray.
Bind point to camp is a long, quiet walk of shame.
Fell over in front of everyone. Please carry on, nothing to see.
Experience bar went backwards. Painful to watch.
I was winning, right up until I was not.
My last words were 'it is only blue'.
Dead in {zone}. If you pass a gravestone with my name, say hello.
I was so sure I had that one.
Released, rebound and ready for round two. Mostly.
Read the con colour before pulling. Lesson learned, again.
Death is just the bind point's way of saying hello.
Died deep in {zone}. My bind feels a world away.
Second death of the night. Taking it as a sign to rest soon.
Ran out of mana and luck at the same time.
Pet died, then I died. Teamwork.
Couldn't out-heal that one. Embarrassing for a healer.
Got spotted, got flattened. So much for stealth.
Took the whole camp on my shield. The shield survived, I did not.
Kited it straight into another pack. Well done, me.
Guild, I died. Please do not ask how.
Evening all. Just died in {zone}. Off to start the walk back.
Dying at my level costs a lot of experience. Ouch.
Died, but at my level it barely stings. Back to it.
Released to bind. Somewhere King Arthur is shaking his head.
Released to bind. Even Odin would wince at that fight.
Released. The Morrigan was not smiling on me today.
Oof. Sorry to hear it.
Happens to the best of us.
Walk it off. Well, run it off.
Been there. Twice today, in fact.
Pray at your gravestone on the way back.
That sort of camp has killed me more times than I can count.
Rest in peace, briefly.
Hope the walk back is short.
Ouch. Watch the adds next time.
Brave of you to say so in public.
Ha. Welcome to the gravestone club, we meet often.
Do not forget the healer if you lost constitution.
Chin up. The experience comes back.
Unlucky. Take a breather before you head back.
Unlucky. Someone with a rez might be close by.
Every great hunter has a few gravestones behind them.
Those things are nastier than they look.
Back on the horse. Well, the horses only go to town, but you know what I mean.
Thank you for the rez! Back on my feet.
Up again. Rez sickness or not, I am grateful.
Many thanks, kind stranger. You saved me a long walk.
Alive again. Everything feels a bit wobbly.
Rez sickness is no fun, but it beats the walk back.
Brought back from the brink. I owe you one.
Thank you! Sitting for a moment while the sickness wears off.
Back from the dead and slightly embarrassed.
Thanks for the raise. Let us never speak of what happened.
On my feet again. That was a close one.
Bless whoever just rezzed me.
Up, dusted off, and ready to try again. Carefully this time.
Resurrection illness is setting in. Give me a minute.
Never thought I would be so happy to see a healer.
Alive! My gear is a little worse for wear, but I am alive.
Thanks, friend. That would have been a long corpse run.
Rez accepted with gratitude. Now, where was I?
Thank you! Back to work in {zone}.
Breathing again. Not taking that for granted.
Brought back in one piece. Mostly one piece.
Back on my feet. Low health, low mana, high spirits.
Raised from the dirt. Somebody tell my pride it can come back too.
Rezzed and rested. The camp will not know what hit it.
Ah, sweet life. Thank you kindly.
Healers have my undying gratitude. Well, my less often dying gratitude.
Guild, someone kind just rezzed me. Faith in the realm restored.
Evening all. Back up after a nasty death in {zone}.
Thank you! Avalon smiles on me today.
Thanks for the rez. Odin is not ready for me yet.
Thanks for the rez. The Tuatha de Danann must be watching over me.
Welcome back.
Glad you are up. Take it easy for a bit.
Back from the dead, eh? Nicely done.
Rest off the sickness before you pull again.
Good to see you on your feet.
Lucky someone was close. Count your blessings.
Welcome back to the land of the living.
Nice. Saves a long walk.
Wait for full mana before you start again.
Glad to hear it. Do not make a habit of dying.
Healers are worth their weight in gold, I say.
Good. We need you up and swinging.
Ding! Level {level}. Off to find my trainer.
Level {level} already? Feels like yesterday I was swatting rats.
Finally hit {level}. The grind was worth it.
Another level, another visit to the trainer.
{level} at last. My trainer will be pleased to see me.
New level, fresh specialization points to spend. Decisions, decisions.
That last bubble took forever. Level {level} now.
Up a level. I can feel the difference already.
Hit {level} on the last pull. What timing.
Time to look for a new camp, these all con green now that I am {level}.
Ding. Small step for the realm, big step for me.
The monsters here suddenly look a lot smaller.
Training points burning a hole in my pocket. Back to town!
Celebrating level {level} with a nice sit by the campfire.
Up again! Every level gets a little harder to earn.
Still terrified of orange cons at {level}. Some things never change.
Proud moment. Level {level}, and no deaths on the way.
That ding never gets old.
Levelled up in {zone}. A fine place to grow stronger.
Grew a little stronger today. Level {level}.
New level! Off to see if any better armour fits me now.
Woo! Another bubble filled, another level earned.
Another level down. The road to fifty is long but I am walking it.
Fifty! I never thought I would see the day.
Level fifty. Now the real work begins.
Halfway to fifty, more or less. Feeling proud.
Level five at last. Time to visit my trainer and choose my path.
Fifteen now. Dun Abermenai is calling my name.
Twenty! Thidranki Faste, here I come.
Old enough for the frontier now, young enough to be nervous about it.
Darkness Falls is starting to look possible at {level}.
One more level closer to standing on a keep wall.
Guild, just hit {level}. Off to train.
Evening all. Small celebration here, level {level} at last.
{guild} has another level {level} in its ranks!
New styles to learn and new ways to swing. Level {level}.
Shield arm is stronger, sword arm is stronger. Level {level}.
New level, new heals. The group will be glad.
My pet seems to have grown a little too. Level {level}!
Quieter on my feet and sharper with the blade. Level {level}.
Shooting straighter already. Level {level}!
New level, more mana to play with. Lovely.
More songs, more spells, more ways to help. Level {level}.
Level {level}. Off to Camelot to see my trainer.
Ding! Back to Jordheim for training.
Tir na Nog, here I come for training. Level {level}!
Grats!
Gratz, well earned.
Congratulations! The realm grows stronger.
Grats! Do not forget your trainer.
Nicely done. Onward to the next one.
Gratz! Enjoy it before the next bar starts.
Well done! Every level counts.
Grats, friend. Think hard before you spend those points.
Congratulations. Long road, but you are walking it.
Ding grats!
Grats! A toast to you tonight.
Excellent. Keep it up.
Grats! Feels good, does it not?
Well earned, I am sure.
Congrats! New camps await.
Grats! Soon you will be out-levelling me.
Grats, and mind the new con colours.
Hurrah! Another step for the realm.
Gratz. The road to fifty gets shorter.
Fine work. Grats.
Grats from me too.
Congratulations! Your trainer will be pleased.
Grats! Keep swinging.
Huzzah, well done!
